sourceTitle: USGS — How Much Water is There on Earth?
exactSourceStatements: the oceans hold about 96.5 percent of all Earth's water
Of total freshwater, over 68 percent is locked up in ice and glaciers.
Another 30 percent of freshwater is in the ground.
notUsed: Toplam su hacmi (332.5 milyon mil küp) soruya çevrilmedi: birim dönüşümü Kurmancî'de doğrulanmamış.
